intro.data: A record bundles a name and an age. The tray holds extractors; bring the right one onto the board and wire the record to the NAME. Two extractors return an A — one gives the right name, the other the wrong one — and one returns the age instead. Leave the wrong ones in the tray.
intro.alchemy: A compound bundles salt and sulfur. The tray holds extractors; bring the right one onto the board and wire the compound to the SALT. One is right, one wrong, one draws the sulfur instead. Leave the wrong ones in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: A blend bundles light and heat. The tray holds extractors; bring the right one onto the board and wire the blend to the LIGHT. One is right, one wrong, one draws the heat instead. Leave the wrong ones in the tray.
intro.abstract: (a,b) is the pair holding both a and b; π₁ pulls out the first component, π₂ the second. From the tray bring the genuine first projection and wire A×B to A. Here (3,4) ↦ 3 under π₁; leave the impostor (and π₂, which returns 4) in the tray.

goal.data: Bring the right extractor from the tray and wire the record to the name (Ada).
goal.alchemy: Bring the right extractor from the tray and wire the compound to the salt.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the right extractor from the tray and wire the blend to the light.
goal.abstract: Bring π₁ from the tray and wire A×B to A, recovering the first component.

afterSuccess.data: Get Name recovered exactly the name that went into the record. The look-alike was the same type but returned the wrong name. A product's projections faithfully read each component back out.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Salt Out recovered exactly the salt in the compound. The look-alike returned the wrong one. Projections faithfully read each component.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Draw Light recovered exactly the light in the blend. The look-alike returned the wrong one. Projections faithfully read each component.
afterSuccess.abstract: The true projection returned the bundled component; the look-alike did not.

reveal.summary: A product A×B has projections π₁ : A×B → A and π₂ : A×B → B that read each component back. They must return the actual bundled value.
reveal.moreFormal: What makes A×B a product is the universal property (next puzzle): any pair of maps into A and B factors uniquely through it.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: record.name and record.age — accessors that return the stored value.
